intents.action_domain: compose and send a kudos wish to a teammate
intents.outcome: the kudos is persisted to Supabase and the sender is returned to the board with confirmation

justification: One user-facing intent. The raw task text carries no conjunction: 'Implement the Send Kudos wishes page, use Supabase local project' names one screen and the store it writes to. The form's parts — recipient, danh hiệu, message, hashtags, images, anonymous toggle — are fields of one submission, not separate (actor, action-domain, outcome) triples; none of them is independently useful without the others. Persistence is the same intent's storage, not a second intent: the seeded profiles and hashtags tables exist only to make this one submission valid (clarifications.md decision 6), and the /kudos board is explicitly out of scope (decision 1), so no second reading/browsing intent is in play.
